what_changed: CFPB advisory opinion that 'Covered EWA' earned wage access products are not credit under Regulation Z and that certain EWA fees and tips are not finance charges; also withdraws a proposed interpretive rule.
rationale: Earned wage access is outside the consumer-loan servicing scope unless the deployment services EWA products; the opinion concludes covered EWA is not credit. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
